out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: A handwashing sign was not observed posted at the hand sink
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS GAVE PIC A HANDWASHING SIGN TO POST.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Observed Raw shelled eggs being store over ready-to-eat food in the 2DR glass slide cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE RAW SHELLED EGGS TO THE BOTTOM OF AN ADJACENT COOLER.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: COOKED CHICKEN (47F) AND TOMATO SOUP (49F) WERE STORED IN TRUE 2-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEMS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: AMBIENT TEMPERATURE OF TURBO-AIR 1-DOOR PREP COOLER WAS 49F, AND TRUE 2-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER WAS 49F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. (1) CFM HAS RELOCATED FOOD ITEMS TO OTHER COOLERS OR DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEMS AS PER STORAGE TIME; (2) PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE UNITS AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED A SPRAY NOZZLE ATTACHED TO HOSE BIBB AT THE MOP SINK WITHOUT AN ATMOSPHERIC BREAKER.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PLEASE INSTALL A WATER WASTING TEE OR A PRESSURE BLEEDING DEVICE AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS. EHS SHARED PICTURES OF WATER WASTING TEE AND PRESSURE BLEEDING VALVE WITH CFM.
